methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2019 10-K); 'Consumers are increasingly turning to online sources for viewing and purchasing content, which is reducing the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and subscribers to NBCUniversal’s cable networks even as it makes Cable Communications’ high-speed internet services more important to consumers'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2019 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior driven by online video distribution platforms for viewing content continue to adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. Consumers are increasingly turning to online sources for viewing and purchasing content, which is reducing the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and subscribers to NBCUniversal’s cable networks even as it makes Cable Communications’ high-speed internet services more important to consumers.' At the same time it is developing its own direct-to-consumer service: 'the development of Peacock, our direct-to-consumer streaming service that will feature NBCUniversal content'. The stock trades at 13.9x FY20E — a discount to its own history. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2019 10-K); 'Consumers are increasingly turning to online sources for viewing and purchasing content, which is reducing the number of Cable Communications’ video customers and subscribers to NBCUniversal’s cable networks even as it makes Cable Communications’ high-speed internet services more important to consumers'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.04x; +7% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.09; conservative 2yr +20%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY10-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +1.4%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.7%/yr (FY10-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +25.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2020-06-12) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.04x (3.7% downside to Bear $38 / +82.5% upside to Bull $72) | Adj composite 1.90 vs market 1.99: gap -0.09 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +7% above the EPP floor $37 (13x FY20E $2.83) | Conservative 2-yr case: +19.6% total (+9.8%/yr) | At 13.9x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $52 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -4.7% in Q1 2020, forward revenues -0.9% (no FY20 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2020 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
